messages:
Jun: Quick non-work question — pick one snack that instantly throws you back to childhood. Only one pick!
Olivia: Dunkaroos, forever. The frosting dunk > everything. :star-struck:
Matt: Fruit by the Foot. The smell of the wrapper is absurdly specific.
Anya: My grandma's oatmeal-raisin cookies. Weird but the exact taste memory. :cookie:
Sam: Sunflower seeds — cracking them in the car after baseball practice. Tiny ritual. :seedling:
Olivia: Also those tiny boxes of raisins felt like a fancy adult snack.
Jun: Love these. @Anya would you share the cookie recipe?
Anya: Sure — I’ll drop it later (no eggs, no mixer). Super simple. :)
Matt: Temp poll? 1) Dunkaroos 2) Fruit by the Foot 3) Raisin boxes 4) Oatmeal cookies
Olivia: 1 :)
Sam: 4 for me
Jun: Votes locked in 30s — also shouting out the nostalgia power of packaging.
Jun: Results: Dunkaroos 1, Fruit by the Foot 1, Raisin boxes 1, Oatmeal cookies 2 — oatmeal wins? Unexpected but delightful.
Olivia: Oatmeal takes it. We need a snack day. :tada:
Anya: I’ll bring a batch next week to the kitchen. 
Matt: Remind me to bring coffee. Winning snacks need proper fuel. :coffee:
